Package models

Class Reservation

java.lang.Object
models.Reservation
public class Reservation extends Object
Represents a suite reservation made by a guest in the MIRAGE system.

A Reservation captures the guest, the suite booked, the stay window (check-in / check-out dates), the computed total room cost, and the current lifecycle status. Instances are created by the application when booking a suite and are hydrated from the database by ReservationDAO.

Database mapping: reservation table.

  • Constructor Details

    • Reservation

      public Reservation(int guestId, int suiteId, LocalDate checkIn, LocalDate checkOut)
      Creates a new Reservation for the given guest and suite. reservationId is left at its default (0) until the record is persisted and the key is set via setReservationId(int). total_cost and status are populated after persistence.
      Parameters:
      guestId - the ID of the guest making the reservation; must be positive
      suiteId - the ID of the suite being booked; must be positive
      checkIn - the check-in date; must not be null or in the past
      checkOut - the check-out date; must be strictly after checkIn
